Package dev.adlin.vts4j

Interface VTSClient

All Known Implementing Classes:
VTSClientImpl
public interface VTSClient
The primary high-level client interface for interacting with the VTube Studio Public API.

Provides full control over the connection lifecycle, token authentication, request dispatching, and event subscription management workflows.

    • authenticate

      @NonNull CompletableFuture<String> authenticate(@NonNull PluginMeta pluginMeta)
      Requests a brand new authentication token from VTube Studio for the specified plugin metadata.

      This will trigger a pop-up confirmation window inside the VTube Studio UI for the end-user.

      Parameters:
      pluginMeta - the metadata configuration of the plugin requesting access
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture that resolves to the newly issued unique authentication token string

    • authenticate

      void authenticate(@NonNull PluginMeta pluginMeta, @NonNull String authenticationToken)
      Authenticates the plugin session instantly using a previously saved existing authentication token.
      Parameters:
      pluginMeta - the metadata configuration of the plugin
      authenticationToken - the pre-issued token string to authenticate with

    • subscribe

      CompletableFuture<Response> subscribe(@NonNull Class<? extends Event> eventClass, @NonNull com.google.gson.JsonObject eventConfig)
      Subscribes the current plugin session to a specific system event type using extended configuration arguments.

      Re-subscribing to an already active event type will seamlessly overwrite its previous parameters. For details regarding available event names and payloads, see the VTube Studio Events Guide.

      Parameters:
      eventClass - the class type of the target Event to subscribe to
      eventConfig - custom JSON configuration properties and filters specific to the event type
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture containing the server response acknowledgment indicating operation status

    • registerEventListener

      void registerEventListener(@NonNull Listener listener)
      Registers an event listener object within the client's internal event bus.

      The registered instance will intercept notifications for any system events that have been activated using the subscribe methods.

      Parameters:
      listener - an instance of a custom class implementing the marker Listener interface
